title: Magnetic Clear Phone Case for Apple iPhone 16 - Brand New
categoryName: Cell Phones & Accessories:Cell Phone Accessories:Cases, Covers & Skins
descriptionText: The Phone Magnetic Clear Case for iPhone 16 is a back case designed specifically for Apple's iPhone 16 model. It features a clear design, allowing the phone's original color to show through. The case is magnetic, providing secure closure and easy access to the device.
